The **raw** tier is the intermediate source stage of Pipeline B: NAMRIA shapefiles converted to
GeoJSON by `namria_converter.py`, before any PSGC enrichment. It is kept in-repo for
traceability — most users should use the curated [hierarchical per-class files](index.qmd) instead.

## What it is

`adm0`–`adm4.geojson` — the NAMRIA administrative-boundary shapefiles (v2023-11-06), converted to
GeoJSON and simplified (Douglas-Peucker, default tolerance `0.005°`). No PSGC properties are
present yet; only the original NAMRIA attributes.

::: {.callout-note}
Intermediate pipeline stage — most users want the curated
[hierarchical per-class files](index.qmd) instead.
:::

## File inventory

Kept in-repo at `2023-10-24/raw_t0p005/` for traceability:

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `adm0.geojson`–`adm4.geojson` | NAMRIA boundaries (shapefile v2023-11-06) converted to GeoJSON and simplified; original NAMRIA attributes only, **no PSGC properties yet** |
| `huc_adm2_mapping.json` | the HUC / Metro-Manila-district / SGA lookup used to reconcile parents (see [HUC mapping generation](../toolchain/huc-mapping.qmd)) |
| `diff.json` | conversion reconciliation diff |
| `summary.md` | human-readable conversion summary |

The conversion runs Douglas-Peucker simplification at a default tolerance of `0.005°` (hence the
`_t0p005` directory name). Full parameters are in [Pipeline B](../toolchain/pipeline-geo.qmd).

## Re-running with a different tolerance

```bash
brgybnd convert-geo --tolerance 0.01
```

## Download (in-repo)

```bash
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/main/2023-10-24/raw_t0p005/adm4.geojson
```
